observations: Photo 0 shows a black mirrorless camera with a lens attached, placed on a blue textured surface. The camera body has 'LUMIX' and 'G' visible on the top. The lens has '14-140' printed on it.

Photo 1 shows the same camera from a top-down angle with the LCD screen open, displaying 'Please set the clock'. The camera is next to a battery and a charger. The charger has 'LUMIX' printed on it. The battery is labeled 'LUMIX' and has a '3.0V' marking.
The camera appears to be in used condition with some minor scuffs and dust, especially on the lens and body.
No visible damage to the body or lens, but no close-up of the sensor or internal components.
No power-on test or functional demonstration is shown.

claims.claim: Neatly used Lumix G7 mirrorless camera.
claims.evidence: The brand 'Lumix' is visible in photo 0 and photo 1, but the model 'G7' is not readable on the camera body or any label. The camera appears used, but 'neatly used' is subjective and not verifiable from photos alone.
Photo 1 shows two batteries and one charger next to the camera.

risks.risk: Camera may not power on or function properly.
risks.proof: A video or photo showing the camera turning on, displaying the menu, and taking a photo.

risks.risk: Lens may have internal damage or scratches not visible in photos.
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the lens front element and rear element, or a video showing the lens being touched and moved.

risks.risk: Battery may be dead or not hold charge.
risks.proof: Video showing the camera operating for 30 seconds with the battery inserted.

risks.risk: Charger may be faulty or not compatible.
risks.proof: Photo of the charger's output ports and a test video showing it charging the battery.

proof_requests: Video showing the camera powering on and taking a photo.
Close-up photo of the lens front and rear elements.
Video showing the camera operating with the battery inserted.
Photo of the charger's output ports and a test video showing it charging the battery.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
